predecessors.name: Belgian Congo
predecessors.text: Urundi, the southern half of the Belgian-administered Ruanda-Urundi: 'Part of Ruanda-Urundi: 1916–1962'

ledger.x: 1 July 1962: Burundi becomes independent of Belgium as a kingdom under Mwami Mwambutsa IV.
28 November 1966: Prime Minister Micombero deposes Ntare V and abolishes the monarchy; Burundi becomes a republic.
2019: the political capital moves from Bujumbura to Gitega; Bujumbura stays the economic capital.

wars.name: Burundian Civil War
wars.outcome: The infobox dates it '21 October 1993 – 15 May 2005'; the page describes 'persistent violence between Hutu rebels and the Tutsi majority army'.

wars.name: Second Congo War
wars.outcome: The page lists Burundi among the foreign state actors (Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi) and says 'Burundi also retaliated, occupying a portion of northeastern Congo'; the war 'officially ended on 18 July 2003'.

certainty.note: Inherited colonial-era boundaries (Ruanda-Urundi split 'along traditional lines' in 1962); the page records no change or dispute since.
